## ✅ Patterns Checklist
- [ ] Custom hooks follow `use` prefix convention and encapsulate logic properly
- [ ] Provider pattern used appropriately for context sharing
- [ ] Compound components maintain proper composition structure
- [ ] Render props pattern not used
- [ ] Builder pattern used correctly for RTK Query endpoints
- [ ] Factory pattern generates consistent API hooks
- [ ] Variant pattern implemented with `cva` for component styling
- [ ] Observer pattern includes proper cleanup in useEffect
- [ ] Ref forwarding pattern used with proper TypeScript typing
- [ ] Redux Toolkit Query patterns followed for state management
- [ ] Selector pattern used for derived state and memoization
- [ ] Anti-patterns avoided (prop drilling, missing dependencies, inline objects)
